native.query:
SELECT
  SUM(total_sales_amount) AS ca_total
FROM
  gold_daily_sales
WHERE
  1 = 1 [[AND {{date_filter}}]];

SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(total_sales_amount)::numeric
        / NULLIF(SUM(completed_transactions), 0),
        2
    ) AS panier_moyen
FROM gold_daily_sales
WHERE 1=1 [[AND {{date_filter}}]];

SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(cancelled_transactions)::numeric
        / NULLIF(SUM(total_transactions), 0)
        * 100,
        2
    ) AS taux_annulation_pct
FROM gold_daily_sales
WHERE 1=1 [[AND {{date_filter}}]];

SELECT
    transaction_date,
    total_sales_amount AS ca
FROM gold_daily_sales
WHERE 1=1 [[AND {{date_filter}}]]
ORDER BY transaction_date;

SELECT
    category_name,
    total_sales_amount AS ca
FROM gold_sales_by_category
ORDER BY ca DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    transaction_date,
    total_sales_amount       AS ca,
    cancelled_transactions   AS annulations,
    completed_transactions   AS ventes
FROM gold_daily_sales
WHERE 1=1 [[AND {{date_filter}}]]
ORDER BY transaction_date;

SELECT
    transaction_date,
    cancellation_rate_pct AS taux_annulation_pct
FROM gold_daily_sales
WHERE 1=1 [[AND {{date_filter}}]]
ORDER BY transaction_date;

card.name: Répartition hebdomadaire par jour de la semaine

native.query:
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(transaction_date, 'Day') AS jour_semaine,
    EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM transaction_date) AS ordre,
    SUM(total_sales_amount) AS ca,
    SUM(total_transactions) AS transactions
FROM gold_daily_sales
WHERE 1=1 [[AND {{date_filter}}]]
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY ordre;

SELECT
    product_name,
    total_sales_amount       AS ca,
    completed_quantity       AS quantite,
    unique_completed_customers AS clients_uniques
FROM gold_sales_by_product
ORDER BY ca DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    category_name,
    total_sales_amount AS ca
FROM gold_sales_by_category
ORDER BY ca DESC;

SELECT
    category_name,
    total_transactions            AS transactions,
    total_sales_amount            AS ca,
    avg_completed_transaction_amount AS panier_moyen,
    completed_quantity            AS quantite_vendue,
    cancellation_rate_pct         AS taux_annulation_pct
FROM gold_sales_by_category
ORDER BY ca DESC;

card.name: Scatter : volume vs panier moyen (par produit)

native.query:
SELECT
    product_name,
    completed_quantity       AS quantite,
    avg_completed_transaction_amount AS panier_moyen,
    total_sales_amount       AS ca
FROM gold_sales_by_product
WHERE completed_quantity > 0;

SELECT
    category_name,
    cancellation_rate_pct/100 AS taux_annulation_pct,
    total_transactions   AS transactions
FROM gold_sales_by_category
WHERE total_transactions >= 10   -- évite le bruit
ORDER BY taux_annulation_pct DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    customer_segment,
    total_sales_amount          AS ca,
    total_transactions          AS transactions,
    unique_completed_customers  AS clients_uniques,
    avg_completed_transaction_amount AS panier_moyen
FROM gold_sales_by_segment
ORDER BY ca DESC;

SELECT
    customer_segment,
    avg_completed_transaction_amount AS panier_moyen
FROM gold_sales_by_segment
ORDER BY panier_moyen DESC;

card.name: Répartition en fonction des moyens de paiement

native.query:
SELECT
    payment_method,
    COUNT(*)                   AS nb_transactions,
    SUM(amount)                AS ca
FROM gold_transactions_enriched
WHERE status = 'completed'
  [[AND {{date_filter}}]]
  [[AND {{country_filter}}]]
GROUP BY payment_method
ORDER BY ca DESC;

SELECT
    country              AS country_code,
    total_sales_amount   AS ca,
    total_transactions   AS transactions
FROM gold_sales_by_country
ORDER BY ca DESC;

SELECT
    country              AS country_code,
    total_sales_amount   AS ca,
    total_transactions   AS transactions
FROM gold_sales_by_country
ORDER BY ca DESC;

SELECT
    country,
    cancellation_rate_pct/100 AS taux_annulation_pct,
    total_transactions    AS transactions
FROM gold_sales_by_country
WHERE total_transactions >= 20
ORDER BY taux_annulation_pct DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    customer_segment,
    ROUND(AVG(discount_rate) * 100, 2) AS remise_moyenne_pct,
    COUNT(*) AS nb_transactions
FROM gold_transactions_enriched
WHERE status = 'completed'
GROUP BY customer_segment
ORDER BY remise_moyenne_pct DESC;

card.name: Taux d'annulation par moyen de paiement

native.query:
SELECT
    payment_method,
    COUNT(*)                                              AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)   AS annulations,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS taux_annulation_pct
FROM gold_transactions_enriched
GROUP BY payment_method
ORDER BY taux_annulation_pct DESC;

-- Cohérence Gold vs Silver
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold_transactions_enriched) AS gold_count,
    (SELECT SUM(total_transactions) FROM gold_daily_sales) AS daily_total,
    (SELECT SUM(total_transactions) FROM gold_sales_by_country) AS country_total,
    (SELECT SUM(total_transactions) FROM gold_sales_by_category) AS category_total;
